about: Pure-Ergo gobind SoA type/decl/binding tables, Go-to-Ergo mapping, refusal closure, nonnil/totality provers, and staleness checks.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-facts-meet-ignores-other-platforms
mutants.rule: MeetFacts keeps only facts proven across every target platform.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-isbinder-admits-predeclared
mutants.rule: IsBinder rejects predeclared universe/prelude names so generated parameters never shadow them.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-nonnil-fact-ignored
mutants.from: let hasNonNil = useFacts && HasFact(ctx.Facts, declTarget, FactNonNilResult)
mutants.to: let hasNonNil = false && useFacts && HasFact(ctx.Facts, declTarget, FactNonNilResult)
mutants.rule: Functions proven non-nil on (*T, error) must map their result to go.Ref[T] rather than Option.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-merge-drops-divergent-field
mutants.rule: Struct merging across platforms records divergent fields as refused members.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-close-ignores-local-refused
mutants.rule: CloseWith refuses declarations that reference a locally refused type.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-escape-ignores-other-lines
mutants.rule: Other compiler escape diagnostics at the same line/col poison non-escaping reads verdicts.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-total-allows-int-div-by-var
mutants.rule: Integer division or remainder is total only when the divisor is a non-zero constant.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-nonnil-ret-accepts-nil
mutants.rule: A return path whose pointer and error proof both fail must reject non-nil proof.

mutants.name: selfhost-gobind-gobind-stale-ignores-content-diff
mutants.rule: Stale reports any content mismatch between committed and freshly written bindings.
